note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown; no worker specimen was available and the worker is taken from Wasmann (1902); the lectotype measurements duplicate those in the text and are not given separately; synonymy citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow; nasus pale red; antennae light brown; thorax, legs and abdomen pale yellow. Head covered with minute hairs throughout, with a pair of long setae on the vertex and a pair on the face below the base of the nasus; nasus covered with minute hairs and with a few longer hairs at the tip; anterior margin of pronotum with long and short hairs, lateral margins with one or two long hairs; abdominal tergites and sternites with long and short hairs throughout. Body length 3.20–3.60 mm. Head capsule broadly pyriform; width only slightly less than the length excluding nasus (1.53 mm long including nasus, 0.95–1.00 mm long excluding nasus, 0.88–0.90 mm wide); in lateral view slightly depressed at the base of the nasus; without nasus swelling. Nasus subcylindrical, not upturned at the tip (0.53–0.58 mm long; nasus length/head length index 0.53–0.60). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 subequal to segment 3. Mandibles vestigial, each with a longer spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly notched at the middle; posterior margin straight (0.15–0.20 mm long, 0.40–0.43 mm wide).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: According to Wasmann (1902): body slightly larger than that of the soldier (3.5–4.0 mm); white, head reddish yellow, divided at the middle by a white I-shaped line (probably the coronal suture). Antennae 13-segmented; segments round, the last few almost not longer than wide. Postclypeus transversely broad, inflated, with a median line. Anterior lobe of pronotum with a distinct notch at the middle.
